manifesto.title: If you want to discover the real Nicaragua,
manifesto.description: Thousands of travelers are part of the community that knows how to travel. Our responsibility is to teach you destinations around the world and accompany you during your experience.

guides.question: How does the volcanologist accompaniment work?
guides.answer: All of our ascents to active craters (such as Telica Volcano, Cerro Negro or Masaya) are supervised by experienced local guides and volcano specialists, with gas monitoring equipment and satellite communication backup.

modify.question: Can I modify the itinerary proposed by the AI?
modify.answer: Absolutely. The artificial intelligence builds the optimal topographic and logistics base; afterwards, a senior travel designer on our team fine-tunes every detail to your pace and individual preferences.

transfers.question: What kind of internal transfers are used?
transfers.answer: We use luxury off-road vehicles with professional chauffeurs, seaplanes and private speedboats for the Solentiname archipelago and the islets of Granada.

destinations.question: What destinations can I find at Momotombo Travels?
destinations.answer: We specialize in Nicaragua, covering everything from the colonial gems of Granada and León to the sacred geology of Ometepe, the surf of Costa Esmeralda and Caribbean rest on Corn Island.
